hypothesis: Directed public role-code and compositional features, trained with explicit asymmetric loss for rare task-beneficial native memory interventions, yield at least one useful early intervention without degrading the frozen F60 on independently unseen original-order and rotated-order synthetic tasks.

online_method.candidate_actions: Only unique exact native ACTION.actions retained-memory alternatives different from frozen F60 next state
online_method.feature_definition: Use F71's 12 source-public action differences plus 8 directed role-code counts, 4 current-event-endpoint-incident role membership counts, 4 adjacent same-role directed code pair counts; all normalized exactly as preregistered F74.
online_method.model: 28 trainable signed int8 weights; intercept included as F71 feature zero; logistic probability of beneficial intervention
online_method.decision: Choose the legal candidate with highest calibrated probability only when its probability is strictly >0.90, otherwise perform original F60. No persistent state beyond 12 retained lossless 12-byte records.

offline_training.labels: Each candidate action from a TRAIN public prefix receives beneficial only if its unchanged-F60 suffix solves the TRAIN question while the exact F60 next-state suffix does not; all harmful or neutral candidates are negative. Future public/question only offline TRAIN teacher.
offline_training.loss: Weighted logistic binary cross entropy via sequential deterministic SGD (no validation hyperparameter choice), three epochs, learning rate 0.025, beneficial sample weight 128, harmful sample weight 1, neutral sample weight 0.01.
offline_training.weight_finalization: round each learned coefficient times 32 and clamp to signed int8 [-127,127]
offline_training.order: ascending train seed, family (-2 then -1), event index, ACTION.actions native candidate order
